_comment: A broken deep cavalry block whose front rank starts only 40 wu short of a hill keeps its front rank with it. Team 1's 80 horses (default Cavalry geometry: 9 files by 9 ranks, about 320 wu wide and 960 wu deep, rank pitch 120 wu) spawn ALREADY routing (starting_state 3, morale 1.0) facing south, their own back edge, with their front rank at y 1180 and a hill (block terrain, x 780-1040, y 1220-1420) across the eastern half of the block. This is deep-router-rounds-hill.json's staging with the hill moved 180 wu closer (that clip's first draft). The flight's step rounds the hill from the anchor, which is 480 wu behind the front rank, so the front rank meets the hill's north face before the bounded heading turn has swung it clear. The anchor travels west along the face while the front rank's line, grown by its half-width, would run onto it, so the whole block side-steps with its men on their slots, then runs on round the hill. A man also takes part of the change in his own feed-forward on top of his acceleration while it is not slowing: none within 60 wu (3 m) of his slot, rising to all of it from 120 wu (6 m) off (SoldierBodies.flight_accel_share), so the leading men the face held back no longer lose ground as the flight swings round the hill. The flight velocity itself changes no faster than that share can hand on (Unit.flight_velocity_accel: flight_share_max_accel_mult x the bodies' own acceleration, 80 wu/s^2 here), so the side-step eases in and out over several ticks instead of swinging in one, and the leading rank looks along the flight it carries as far as it runs while turning at that rate, so the side-step starts in time (it starts at tick 61, against 73 when it swung in one tick). Figures from full state dumps at the declared ticks, seeds 0 to 4 (all identical: nothing here draws on the seed), each labelled with the tree it was measured on. slot_distance_max (the farthest any man stands from his slot) at ticks 300 and 350: 325.1 and 382.5 wu on c6475b82, before the side-step, with 5 men more than 100 wu off at tick 350 (front-rank men i0-i3 pinned on the face and sliding west along it until about tick 240; measured by the side-step's own PR, not re-measured here); 143.0 and 192.3 wu, with 2 men more than a rank pitch (120 wu) off at tick 350, measured 2026-11-05 on main 806be006 (side-step, no share); 89.9 and 96.7 wu, with no man more than a rank pitch off at any declared tick, measured 2026-11-06 on d2b7e7b4 (side-step and share) against main 806be006. The slot_distance_max pins allow one default Cavalry rank pitch (120 wu: rank_pitch_m 3.0 m x 20 wu/m x Unit.NORMAL_SPACING_SCALE 2.0), which guards the flight-accel share: 806be006 reads 143.0 and 192.3 wu and fails both, c6475b82 fails both, and this branch reads 89.9 and 96.7 wu and passes both. Measured 2026-11-06 on cf24ad95 against main cf24ad95, identical on seeds 0 to 4 (89.9 and 96.7 wu at ticks 300 and 350); the same dump of a git archive of 806be006 read 143.0 and 192.3 wu on seeds 0 to 4. The anchor's tick-240 position pin was (687.3, 811.1): it read (687.3, 811.1) on 806be006 and (686.95, 811.33) on main aef5b476, against (701.8, 911.3) on c6475b82, where the side-step showed as about 100 wu less travel south. Re-pinned with Ezra's in-wave approval (daytb, 2026-11-10) when the flight velocity's change was bounded: the bounded side-step starts earlier and runs west for longer, and the pin now reads (671.74, 783.3) on ef10ac12 on seeds 0 to 4 (all identical; seed 0 is the clip's own seed), against (686.95, 811.33) on main aef5b476 on the same seeds, so tol 5 still covers every seed and main fails the pin. Against c6475b82 the side-step now shows as about 128 wu less travel south. On ef10ac12 slot_distance_max reads 77.1 and 98.8 wu at ticks 300 and 350 (main aef5b476: 89.9 and 96.7), soldiers_in_block_terrain 0 at tick 350, and soldiers_at_block_terrain_edge 4, 3, 2 at ticks 120, 150, 180, as on main. The leading men still touch the face for a while (soldiers_at_block_terrain_edge 4, 3, 2 at ticks 120, 150, 180 on both 806be006 and this branch), since a block starting this close and from rest cannot stop short of it. The tick-8 position pins are setup pins (the spawn), not claims about the fix. A routing unit's rout timer (6 s) runs out at tick 360 and it rallies; the clip ends at tick 352, just before that. A small idle team-0 squadron 600 wu east keeps the router in the close sim tier; all_teams_control leaves both sides without AI. Flat declared map apart from the hill; drill mode. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
